name: Màoxiǎn Túzhōng Quánshēn Gàobái
source:
I arrived, full of spirit, only to find the dungeon already conquered?! While searching for clues to a new one, I ended up helping a village in crisis—gathering materials for every shop! How did I start getting close to all these unique and charming women?! What will become of my adventurer life?!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3633750]Steam[/url]]
